thread:
Alex K: Quick idea — small shell-based rollback helper (we're calling it 'shelllet') to standardize quick rollbacks, pin swaps, and annotated release notes. prototype thoughts below.

Maria: Love that. Can it do: detect current pin, run deploy-bot rollback <rev>, confirm & append to release notes?

Tariq: +1. Also add: dry-run mode, check canary/change window, and a safety prompt. We had a near-miss last week when someone rolled outside the window.

Jamie: This would be great to include in the release checklist. Could be a tiny single-file script that ops can ship in ~/.local/bin so it's easy to run.

Alex K: Sketch of what I'm thinking:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# shelllet small prototype: check pin, show diff, optional rollback
REV=${1:-latest}
DRY=${DRY_RUN:-false}
# query current pin
CURRENT=$(curl -sS "https://deploy-api.internal/pin?service=frontend" | jq -r .pin)
echo "current pin: $CURRENT"
echo "requested: $REV"
if [ "$DRY" = true ]; then
  echo "dry run: will run deploy-bot rollback $REV"
  exit 0
fi
read -p "Confirm rollback to $REV (y/N): " yn
if [ "$yn" != "y" ]; then
  echo "aborting"
  exit 1
fi
# kick deploy-bot via slack CLI / API
slack api chat.postMessage --channel=#release-ops --text "/deploy rollback frontend $REV --annotate=\"rollback:shelllet\""
# append to release notes service
curl -X POST https://release-notes.internal/append -d "service=frontend&note=rollback to $REV (shelllet)"
echo "rollback triggered"
```

Maria: Nice. A couple of items: 1) SAFETY_WINDOW env var, 2) auto-bail with a clear message if outside change window, 3) annotate with who triggered it and link to incident if present. :thumbsup:

Tariq: Also add telemetry: events like rollback_initiated, rollback_confirmed, rollback_failed. Send to infra-events so we can alert on repeated rollbacks.

Alex K: Yep — plan:
- Draft RFC with UX and safety checks
- Prototype single-file shelllet + tests (dry run coverage)
- Add small runbook snippet and update release checklist templates
- Wire telemetry and a minimal ACL check (only release-team role)

Jamie: I'll slot a line into the release checklist template and the pinning quick-reference. Can help with the runbook text.

DeployBot: DeployBot: pinned frontend -> v2026.03.20-rc2. If you need a rollback, run `/deploy rollback frontend v2026.03.20-rc1` or use the shelllet when it's ready.

Alex K: Thanks. I'll open a draft PR by EOD and drop a link here. tagging @release-team for visibility.

Maria: sounds good. Ping me for a quick review when the RFC is up.

Tariq: if you want i can add a tiny integration test that simulates the dry-run flow tomorrow morning.

Alex K: perfect — assigning the prototype to myself, tests to Tariq, checklist update to Jamie. Will update thread with PR/links.

Jamie: :rocket:
